sourceNotes: 日历日期与星期按应用语言显示，周起始日采用系统默认并支持手动选择
新安装按使用地区设置日历默认选项，保留已有日历用户的显示偏好
合并“节气与时令”设置，星期固定显示，简化农历与假期相关选项
减少菜单栏实时预览与磁盘应用排行的重复计算，保持原有数据和采样频率
修复关闭农历后菜单栏仍显示农历的问题，重新开启时恢复原显示方式
修复日历弹窗首次展开时详情和假期概览未完整计入高度的问题
修复菜单栏预览在 Retina 屏幕上的位图缩放问题
修复未覆盖年份沿用假期概览的问题，明日安排小组件区分功能关闭与数据缺失
移除月历中的日干支显示及独立开关，黄历详情仍保留干支信息

en: Format calendar dates and weekdays in the app language; use the system week start by default and allow manual selection
Set calendar defaults by region for new installations while preserving existing calendar users' display preferences
Combine solar terms and seasonal information into one setting, always show weekdays, and simplify lunar and holiday options
Reduce repeated computation in live menu bar previews and per-app disk rankings while preserving displayed data and sampling rates
Fix lunar dates remaining in the menu bar after lunar display is disabled, and restore the previous display mode when it is enabled again
Fix day details and holiday overviews being omitted from the initial calendar popover height measurement
Fix menu bar preview bitmap scaling on Retina displays
Fix holiday overviews appearing for years without supported data; distinguish disabled holiday support from missing data in the tomorrow schedule widget
Remove day-cycle labels and their separate toggle from the month grid while retaining cycle information in almanac details
